_: The Claude plugin (JHD discipline) host: sibling skills exist by name, and the house tail is allowed — but only under `## At JHD`, and only here.
description-scope:
Reading Figma live is capture-figma;
  measuring a built page is audit-build.
contract-read:
The pair is read, not re-described; the brief points at it rather than paraphrasing it. The Figma MCP
cannot replace it: no per-mode code-named tokens, generated CSS, changelog or pair hashes
(`2026-10-17-keep-design-handoff`).
fires-table:
| Situation | Skill |
| --- | --- |
| An export pair exists and code is being written from it | **this skill** |
| No export — reading the design file live (selection, screenshots, variant matrix, copy inventory) | `capture-figma` |
| A page is already built and needs measuring back against the design | `audit-build` |
sibling-skills:
`capture-figma` supplies what a pair cannot carry (renders, prototype detail, REST `--raw` binding
proofs, the live-annotation spot check): reach for it *inside* step 4 when the pair is silent — not instead of it.
ruling-ref-cites: `ruling ref` cites the lock row or ruling that authorised a non-match.
